description: Drape a vintage analog-film aesthetic over any TOP in one call. Chains barrel/pincushion lens distortion → chromatic aberration → vignette → film grain as four inline GLSL passes inside a new baseCOMP. Era presets (super8, vhs, 16mm, 80s_camcorder) load era-correct strength defaults; any per-param override wins. Returns a standard Layer 1 envelope with container path, node paths, output path, preview image, warnings, and the resolved strength values.

ca_strength.description: RGB-split offset magnitude (radial from center). Overrides preset.

distortion_strength.description: Barrel-distortion coefficient (UV warped from center). Overrides preset.

era.description: Era preset that sets default strength values; per-param overrides win.

parent_path.description: Parent network where the vintage-lens container is created (default '/project1').

source_top_path.description: Path of the existing TOP to grade (e.g. '/project1/render1').

vignette_strength.description: Edge darkening amount; 0 disables. Overrides preset.

name: create_vintage_lens
title: Create Vintage Lens
